rules.label: Medic kits (INT, Make a Camp / Safe Rest)

system.description:
You carry INT specialized medic kits that replenish whenever you take a Make a Camp or Safe Rest. You can expend a kit with 1 Action to aid an ally you can touch. The target can immediately expend and roll one of their Hit Die, regaining HP equal to the roll + their STR + your INT. If the target has no Hit Die remaining, you can expend one of your own.

[A] The medic kits are a counter on this feature (INT, refilled by a Field Rest — Make a Camp — or a Safe Rest). Target the ally you touch and use it: the kit is spent, the ally expends their largest Hit Die (yours when they have none) and heals the roll + their STR + your INT (the maximum while Triage! is on them), with an Undo card. From level 11 (Advanced Combat Medic) the card lists the ally's negative conditions with a button to remove one.

[M] Without a target, the kit is spent and the card says what to heal by hand.
